layout_proof.claim: Reuse preserved measured full-header GCC/Clang results; no fresh compile or other profile claim.

semantics.levels: Reported effective levels, including zero tree entries; permanent, copied and temporary ownership UNKNOWN.
semantics.complete: UNKNOWN even for empty LIST; partner and overflow ADD/UPDATE continuations are possible.
semantics.upgrade: All uint8 values opaque; 1 is an upgrade hint, never spend/prerequisite/casting authority.
semantics.free_points: Independent received status, never evidence of skill absence.
semantics.delete: 0x0441 invalidates conservatively using existing framing; no added lengths.
semantics.retention: 256 observed rows maximum; overflow poisons UNKNOWN rather than fabricating absence.
semantics.decision: At most 8 numeric rows, explicit displayed subset/truncation; compact skills section <=2048 UTF-8 bytes.

limits: No allocation, casting, SQL, live telemetry, inference or milestone acceptance.
